integrity: The determinant, strict ordering, and uniform asymptotic are proved analytically; small-dimensional computations are corroboration only. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to complete split graphs, uniform continuous volume, and the stated coordinate realization. Does not imply inclusion monotonicity for arbitrary convex bodies or provide a classification of general split graphs.
title: Strict isotropic-constant interpolation in complete split-graph stable-set polytopes
